# Animated lower thirds, show opens and title reveals in HyperFrames

**Names, places and show titles become lower thirds, speaker plates, show opens and glitch or CRT reveals that hold for two reads.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_8f8381043403.webp" alt="Broadcast titles over soft bokeh: &quot;The Quiet Hour&quot; show open, a name-and-role lower third and a glitch reveal of &quot;CLEAR SIGNAL&quot;." width="480"></p>

Nine title templates with broadcast-grade presets: name and place lower thirds, speaker plates (two-line, ticker, caption bar, title card, corner tag), a podcast or show open, headline write-on reveals, a channel bumper animated on twos, CRT scanline, chrome echo melt and block-glitch title reveals. Presets give hold time from word count, safe areas for 16:9 and 9:16, type scale by frame height, tracking, plate opacity and enter/exit easing, from Netflix and BBC timing rules, EBU safe areas, Material motion, School of Motion, Art of the Title and the Spider-Verse animators. Use when a video needs a lower third, a name or location super, an intro title, a chapter card or a glitch/CRT/chrome text reveal. NOT for subtitles (use caption-styles) or logo animation of a brand mark.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill title-design                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills title-design --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Add a name lower third for "Maya Chen, Head of Design" to ./interview.mp4 at 0:04"
- "Make a 10-second podcast show open with the show name on the beat and two guest plates"
- "Glitch title reveal for "CHAPTER 2" on a transparent background, 16:9"
